question.prompt: Name a spacecraft listed in the “Solar probes” section of the List of Solar System probes.

answers.evidence: Pioneer 5 is listed as a solar orbiter that measured magnetic fields and solar flare particles.
Pioneer 6 is listed as one of a network of solar-orbiting space-weather monitors.
Pioneer 7 is listed as a solar-orbiting monitor of solar wind, cosmic rays, and magnetic fields.
Pioneer 8 is listed as a solar-orbiting space-weather monitor.
Pioneer 9 is listed as a solar-orbiting monitor that operated from 1968 to 1983.
Pioneer-E appears in the solar-probe list even though its launch failed to reach orbit.
Helios A is listed as a probe observing solar wind and other phenomena between Earth and the Sun.
Helios B is listed as a solar probe observing fields, particles, and dust between Earth and the Sun.
ISEE-3 is listed as a solar-observation probe later renamed International Cometary Explorer.
Ulysses is listed for multiple passes observing the Sun's polar regions.
WIND is listed as a solar orbiter making solar-wind measurements.
SOHO is listed as investigating the Sun's core, corona, and solar wind.
ACE is listed as a solar probe conducting solar-wind observations.
Genesis is listed as a solar-wind sample-return probe.
STEREO A is listed as a solar probe imaging coronal mass ejections and other solar phenomena.
STEREO B appears as a separate spacecraft in the solar-probe list.
DSCOVR is listed as monitoring solar wind and coronal mass ejections.
Parker Solar Probe is listed as conducting close-range studies of the solar corona.
Solar Orbiter is listed as an ESA probe studying solar and heliospheric physics.
Aditya-L1 is listed as an ISRO probe observing the solar corona.
SWFO-L1 is listed as monitoring space weather, solar wind, and coronal mass ejections.

question.explanation: These solar probes were designed to operate in heliocentric orbit or at an Earth–Sun Lagrange point. Earth-orbiting solar observatories are excluded from this section, and repeated passes by the same spacecraft count as one answer.
